content.intro: This lesson introduces understanding method resolution order (mro) as part of python object-oriented programming. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: Object-oriented design is useful when state and behavior belong together. Prefer clear interfaces and composition when inheritance would create a fragile hierarchy.
